title: Simple is not the same as easy
body:
When it comes to doing things in life, 'simple' is often misunderstood. Simple sounds easy. But simple is often tedious. Sometimes boring. Often repetitive. And that's exactly why we avoid it.

It feels too basic. Or it feels like too much effort to keep doing. So we stop. Not because it doesn't work, but because we don't stay with it long enough.

Maybe the answer is to accept this: It will feel simple. It will feel repetitive. And I still have to find the time and way to do it. That's where things start working.
